notice: Draft by an agent, written from memory: every attribution, dispute reason and basis citation is unchecked. basis_verified stays false until a person checks the named source, and reviewer stays empty until a named person approves the row. A row with an empty reviewer or disputed true earns no ranking effect. Explore search reads approved rows. Outside production it reads unapproved rows when EXPLORE_FOUNDING_UNVERIFIED is 1.

tiers.founding: The accepted founding text for the concept.
